document: Flight NH106 departs Tokyo Narita at 11:05am and arrives before noon local time in North America -- a good option if you're booking ANA Mileage Club business class from North Asia to North America for 88,000 miles one-way this quarter. Some readers speculate the chart could rise significantly at some unspecified future date, but nothing is confirmed and no new number has been published yet.
